title: VIE region set (frame-major object list)
description: vie.region-set/1 — every region record of an object store, grouped by frame (VIE-SPEC-REP 1.1.0 §R7). Serialized with sorted keys and compact separators; floats use shortest round-trip repr so identical values give identical bytes.

objects_config_sha256.description: binds this derived artifact to the objects config that produced it (1.0.0 §10.2)
